name: Extended Exhale Breathing
equipment: A quiet space, seated or lying down
instructions: Sit or lie down comfortably, and let your first few breaths settle into a natural rhythm.
Inhale through your nose for a count of 4.
Exhale slowly through your nose or mouth for a count of 8 — twice as long as the inhale.
Let your exhale be smooth and unforced, not squeezed out.
Repeat for 6 rounds, noticing your body settling more with each longer exhale.
